answer: Sybil resistance comes from reputation’s exponential temporal decay: with each half-life, past trust contributes half as much, so durable influence requires sustained honest service. EigenTrust-style centrality is computed from normalized, reciprocity-weighted trust and transitive paths; freshly spawned identities, whether named violet, delta, or summit, have near-zero centrality and lack trusted support, so they cannot meet consensus thresholds.
